hooks.command: PROTECTED='.env|secrets/|migrations/|.github/workflows/|package-lock.json|pnpm-lock.yaml'; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$f" ] && echo "$f" | grep -Eq "$PROTECTED"; then echo "BLOCKED: $f is a protected path. Ask the human before changing it." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
